# Ayman Alawwad

> Ayman Alawwad is a PMO and portfolio leader based in Riyadh, with more than ten years of experience bridging strategy and execution across technology, infrastructure and government environments. He has managed and delivered projects and portfolios exceeding SAR 500 million, and has earned the PMP®, PMI-RMP® and P3O® certifications.

Also written: Ayman Al-Awwad, Ayman AlAwwad, Ayman Alawad, أيمن العواد.
